Method & limitations

Built for planning.
Not a substitute for procedure guidance.

The calculator bilinearly interpolates the FAA-published ICAO Cold Temperature Error Table using reported airport temperature and height above airport. Corrections are added to published altitudes; the altimeter setting itself is not changed.

FAA procedures, applicable state rules, operator policy, chart notes, and ATC instructions always take precedence. Coordinate corrections with ATC where required. Baro-VNAV temperature limits are separate.
